title: Filter and sort available workshop equipment
goal: Unifies search, classification and sorting into one state-to-list rendering.
summary: Some equipment has similar names but belongs to different training rooms. The page should be sorted by keywords, training rooms and time at the same time, and other conditions should not be lost by updating one condition.
tasks: completes initial rendering and monitoring of three controls. The search ignores leading and trailing spaces and capitalization. When "All" is selected in the training room, the venue will not be filtered.
Sort by minute number ascending or descending according to the sort control. Each line displays "Name · N minutes".
Show the number of matches as “N items in total”. Use “No matching equipment” when there are no results.

example.code:
const ready = records.filter((item) => item.active);
const ordered = ready.toSorted((a, b) => a.minutes - b.minutes);
example.note: First filter the original data, then sort and update the list. The same rendering function can be shared when the three conditions change.

hint: The rendering function takes the value from the current control every time, and does not continue to filter the results that have been filtered last time.
